item.title: Top 10 AI use cases on X, Nov 8 2026
item.description:
The ten most-engaged X posts from the last 24 hours (Nov 8, 2026) showing people actually using AI. Lauren (poteto)'s Grok Bot music explainer video led by a wide margin, followed by Theo's 22 parallel coding-agent threads, Claude Code driven from a phone, Grok Bot replacing Siri, rival AI Super Bowl ads, a kids' Roblox game built with Claude, a Hermes prediction-league plugin, Grok Bot time savings, a Hermes consumer-spending simulation, and a Claude-built Blender render. It was a quiet Sunday, so engagement past the top few posts is modest. Templated trading-bot profit posts and court-win stories were skipped as engagement bait.

  1. A Grok Bot music explainer video

    Lauren (poteto) had Grok Bot make a video explaining how the Game Boy-style music for her project was made. She used pstack's sharpen and in-your-own-words skills so the agent understood her, and it produced a storyboard and animatic before the full video.

    @poteto on X · 1,272 likes · 61 reposts · 104,261 views

  2. 22 coding-agent threads at once

    Theo showed T3 Code running 22 agent threads in parallel while his inbox stays empty, so in-progress work stays out of the way until it needs him.

    @theo on X · 227 likes · 3 reposts · 9,476 views

  3. Driving Claude Code on a Mac from a phone

    Riley Brown connected Claude Duet to Claude Code on his Mac and walked through editing videos, building apps, computer use and real-time voice coding, all from his phone.

    @rileybrown on X · 164 likes · 6 reposts · 11,269 views

  4. Grok Bot replaces Siri on iPhone

    Scotty Beam says Grok Bot is now his main iPhone assistant and he no longer uses Siri. He published a full setup guide for installing and using it.

    @ScottyBeamIO on X · 161 likes · 9 reposts · 22,536 views

  5. Rival Super Bowl ads from Claude and ChatGPT

    whydeso asked Claude and ChatGPT to each make a Super Bowl ad for its biggest competitor. ChatGPT made a sincere ad for Claude, while Claude tried to sneak a plug for itself into ChatGPT's ad.

    @whydeso on X · 84 likes · 0 reposts · 27,137 views

  6. A Roblox game built with his kids

    Min Choi and his kids built a playable Roblox game without writing code, using Claude Opus 5.5 with the Roblox MCP, Tripo AI for 3D creatures, Claude plus Blender MCP for rigging, and GPT Images 2.5 for textures.

    @minchoi on X · 57 likes · 4 reposts · 10,306 views

  7. Group chats turned into prediction leagues

    Tajudeen spent a week building CALLIT, a Hermes Agent plugin that lets friends make and challenge predictions in group chats, track who was right, and optionally stake crypto.

    @Tajudeen on X · 41 likes · 16 reposts · 1,621 views

  8. Grok Bot saved 50 hours in three weeks

    George (GMFinX) says Grok Bot, at 13 pounds for the first month, has saved him about 50 hours in three weeks, though it refused some tasks in the last few days.

    @GMFinX on X · 26 likes · 1 reposts · 15,039 views

  9. An 11,500-question consumer simulation

    Tommy (Shaughnessy119) ran an 11,500-question simulation with his Hermes agent on the Muse model to model consumer spending habits and map them to stocks.

    @Shaughnessy119 on X · 17 likes · 1 reposts · 2,848 views

  10. Claude builds and renders a monitor in Blender

    AI Workflow Lab had Claude write one Python script that built a 27-inch monitor from 10 parts in Blender, render 375 frames in about 23 minutes, and edit the video without anyone touching Blender.

    @AIWorkflowX on X · 11 likes · 2 reposts · 317 views

item.title: Top 10 AI use cases on X, Nov 7 2026
item.description:
